attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 23 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page's whole account of him is the quotation of Acts 13:1-3, where he is named «Μαναήν τε Ἡρώδου τοῦ τετράρχου σύντροφος», and one sentence saying he fell asleep in peace. The corpus keeps no Manaen, and the sweep found no folder that folds onto the name. The four men named beside him in the verse — Barnabas, Symeon called Niger, Lucius the Cyrenian and Saul — are named in the life in plain words and get no `related` row, because what the page gives is the verse and not an association it states in its own voice. No hymn, no relics, no place.
